name: Alejandro Zumbado Vargas
title: Software Developer
summary: I'm a Computer Engineer graduated from Tecnológico de Costa Rica, with over 4 years building websites, apps, and video games for companies and my own projects. I currently work at a development studio that takes on projects from different companies, building everything from training simulators to AI-powered virtual characters. In my own time, I've also built a news site that updates itself every day and several video games that anyone can play online today. I learn quickly, adapt well to different teams and clients, and I like finishing what I start.

Video games: Games for computer, mobile, and browser

experience.sub: A studio that takes on projects from different companies to build with its team
bullets: Helped build an augmented-reality training simulator for medical staff.
Developed an interactive kiosk application with a camera for a well-known brand campaign.
Contributed to a virtual character powered by artificial intelligence that holds conversations with people.
Collaborated on a web platform connecting companies, and on virtual-reality projects for other clients.
Built and maintained company websites, connecting what users see with the information stored in the system.
Worked on interactive and virtual-reality experiences for different projects.
Was responsible for the entire development of a virtual-reality website for a reconstruction project.
Designed and built an immersive nature experience with more than 5 different scenes.
Improved features on existing web systems, working as part of a cross-functional team.
For a client (Solucom), built a remote gate-opening system: a small computer (Raspberry Pi) connected to the internet that talks to a website to control access.
Worked with different clients on web projects, adapting to each one's needs and short deadlines.

projects.sub: A news site that writes and publishes itself, every day
bullets: Built a system that finds real news, writes it up with the help of artificial intelligence in 4 languages, checks that the information is accurate, and publishes it automatically without anyone doing it by hand.

projects.sub: Playable today from a browser or phone
bullets: Designed and programmed several video games, including one online multiplayer game, available to play directly from the internet.

projects.sub: A system for collecting customer opinions
bullets: Built an app where customers can rate and upload photos of custom 3D-printed figures they bought, with a panel to see all the feedback.
